record.paper_title: Optimal Algorithms for Numerical Integration: Recent Results and Open Problems
record.original_question: Fix d and let D_d be a Jordan measurable domain of volume 1. For the classical smoothness classes F_d^k(D_d), does the asymptotic constant C_{D_d} = lim_{n->infinity} e(n,F_d^k(D_d)) n^(k/d) exist, and if it exists, is it independent of the particular shape of D_d, perhaps under suitable assumptions on the boundary?

evidence.quote: It is known that the weak order e(n,Fkd (Dd)) \u224d n-k/d holds at least for every bounded Lipschitz domain.

We guess that more is true and the asymptotic constant lim n->infty e(n,Fkd (Dd)) \u00b7 nk/d = CDd does not depend on Dd (for fixed d) if Dd is Jordan measurable with \u03bbd(Dd) = 1; possibly under some assumptions on the boundary of Dd.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix an integer $d\ge 1$ and an integer $k\ge 1$. For a bounded Jordan measurable domain $D\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ with Lebesgue measure $\lambda_d(D)=1$, let $F_d^k(D)$ denote the classical smoothness class consisting of all functions $f:D\to\mathbb{R}$ whose partial derivatives up to order $k$ exist and are bounded in absolute value by $1$ on $D$. For $n\in\mathbb{N}$, define the $n$-th minimal worst-case integration error
$$e(n,F_d^k(D))\;=\;\inf_{x_1,\dots,x_n\in D,\;a_1,\dots,a_n\in\mathbb{R}}\;\sup_{f\in F_d^k(D)}\left|\int_D f(x)\,dx-\sum_{i=1}^n a_i f(x_i)\right|.$$
It is known that $e(n,F_d^k(D))\asymp n^{-k/d}$ at least for every bounded Lipschitz domain $D$. 

(a) Does the limit
$$C_D\;=\;\lim_{n\to\infty} e(n,F_d^k(D))\cdot n^{k/d}$$
exist for every Jordan measurable $D$ with $\lambda_d(D)=1$ (possibly under suitable regularity assumptions on the boundary $\partial D$)?

(b) Assuming the limit exists, is the constant $C_D$ independent of the particular shape of $D$ (depending only on $d$ and $k$)?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as a conjecture/open question in surveys on optimal numerical integration. While the weak (order) asymptotic $e(n,F_d^k(D))\asymp n^{-k/d}$ is established for bounded Lipschitz domains, no source found establishes existence of the exact asymptotic constant $C_D$ or its shape-independence beyond special cases such as the cube.

status_evidence.title: Optimal Algorithms for Numerical Integration
status_evidence.snippet: Weak order e(n,F_d^k(D_d)) ≍ n^{-k/d} known for bounded Lipschitz domains; existence and shape-independence of asymptotic constant stated as a conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The existence and shape-independence of the asymptotic constant is conjectured but unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Product rules are optimal for numerical integration in classical smoothness spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes optimal product rules for classical smoothness spaces, primarily on the cube.
status_evidence.claim: Exact asymptotic constants are known in restricted settings (e.g., the cube), not for general Jordan domains.
